propositions: A drainer process killed between _acquire_advisory_lock and _release_advisory_lock leaves a 0-byte enrich-drain.lock file permanently, causing all subsequent drain attempts to fail silently with FileExistsError and return skipped status at INFO level
The existing enrich-drain.lock has no owner stamp, no staleness path, and no reclaim logic, so leaked locks cannot be distinguished from active locks and cannot be reclaimed

Stamping the lock file on acquire with v2 owner metadata and extracting a shared staleness decision core (_stamp_is_stale) from lock_owner allows both mkdir locks and drain locks to reclaim provably-dead or aged-out orphans
A stale drain lock must be reclaimed with exactly one bounded retry on FileExistsError and logged at WARNING with holder name and age to make wedges visible
Doctor's lock-health report must decode the drain lock stamp and report a real staleness verdict instead of not-assessable, so dead-holder drain locks surface as stale-lock findings at exit 1
